title: VnExpress Marathon Hai Phong 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
seo_title: VnExpress Marathon Hai Phong 2026 Review | Vietnam
meta_description: VnExpress Marathon Hai Phong review: a record 134 sub-3 finishers and 1,905 under four hours in December 2025, a fast course. What to expect in 2026.
dek: Hai Phong's December marathon produced more sub-three-hour finishers than any race in Vietnam in 2025. Here is what that edition was like, ahead of 2026.
verdict: VnExpress Marathon Hai Phong has a reputation as a fast marathon. The 2025 edition, in December, had 134 runners finish the full marathon in under three hours, up from 91 in 2024 and the most reported at any marathon in Vietnam, including eight women [1]. Another 1,905 runners finished in under four hours [1]. The organiser's own report attributes that to a course with few intersections, enough width and little traffic disruption [1]. If you want to chase a marathon time in Vietnam, it is a strong target. Note that the report comes from VnExpress, which organises the race.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: The 2025 race was held in Hai Phong in December 2025 [1]. 134 runners finished the marathon in under three hours, including eight women, up from 91 the year before, the highest number of sub-three finishers reported at a marathon in Vietnam [1].
A further 1,905 finished the full marathon in under four hours [1]. Runners came from abroad as well as across Vietnam [1].

sections.heading: Why It Is Fast
paragraphs: Running a sub-three-hour marathon means averaging about 4:26 per kilometre [1]. The report says that kind of pacing needs a course with limited intersections, sufficient width and minimal disruption from traffic, and presents Hai Phong's course as delivering that [1].
For most runners, the practical point is that this is a course where a good day can turn into a personal best.

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a fast marathon in Vietnam and a field full of runners chasing the same goal. The large sub-three and sub-four groups mean you will rarely be running alone.
December in northern Vietnam is cool compared with the rest of Southeast Asia, which helps, but check the forecast and the start time when the 2026 details are published.
This review is compiled from the organiser's published report on the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: Is VnExpress Marathon Hai Phong a fast course?
faqs.answer: By its results, yes. In 2025, 134 runners finished the marathon in under three hours, the most reported at any race in Vietnam, and 1,905 finished in under four hours. The organiser credits a course with few intersections, good width and little traffic.

faqs.question: How many runners break three hours at Hai Phong?
faqs.answer: 134 in 2025, including eight women, up from 91 in 2024. That was the highest number of sub-three-hour finishers reported at a marathon in Vietnam.

faqs.question: Who organises VnExpress Marathon Hai Phong?
faqs.answer: VnExpress, the Vietnamese news publisher, which runs the VnExpress Marathon series in several cities, including Nha Trang, Hanoi and Hai Phong. The Hai Phong race is held in December.
